summary: A supplied vector reconstruction of the British Columbia Power Commission emblem, rebuilt from geometric parts after the image BC Hydro Power Pioneers publishes as the commission's original logo. See package-README.md and review/comparison.webp.

assets.label: British Columbia Power Commission — Emblem
assets.notes: The sunburst behind a white arched plaque, with BC in red over POWER COMMISSION in navy. Power Pioneers identifies the emblem as the commission’s original logo and documents it on the commission’s bright red service trucks. Its designer and exact introduction date are unconfirmed.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied vector reconstruction, not original artwork: the sunburst, arched plaque and frame are geometric constructions and the seventeen letters custom outlines, placed after the Power Pioneers image (rebuild_emblem.py; no automatic tracing). Colours are flat approximations of the image (#FFD800, #E60010, #011842). The source image is kept as a download.
